B lies on segment AD (required by application of Prop 2.7 to line AD cut at B)

Each proposition application correctly identifies the relevant line and points within this single consistent configuration.

No auxiliary geometric constructions are introduced, so there are no opportunities for configuration contradictions. All applications of Book 2 propositions correctly match their preconditions to the established collinear configuration.
